# hpe_morpheus_vdi_gateway (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_vdi_gateway" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_vdi_gateway" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the VDI gateway.
- `name` (String) The name of the VDI gateway.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the VDI gateway.
- `gateway_url` (String) The URL of the VDI gateway.
